messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Probabilistic simulated-annealing search reporting best-found coordinates as decimals

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A simulated-annealing search with exponential cooling (T_{n+1}=0.9995 T_n) initialized from 1000 random 13-point configurations in [0,1]², using Gaussian perturbations σ=T_n/4 and Metropolis acceptance on the minimum-area objective over all 286 triangles, converges to coordinates achieving minimum triangle area ≥ 0.0035, with the best-found configuration approximating a perturbed hexagonal-triangular lattice sheared to fit the unit square."}
